title: He Carries the Lambs
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler of warmth, and tonight is Heavenly Father comforting His tired people: the Shepherd gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart, which is exactly what Willow does when someone small is crying.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because comfort is her gift, and this story is Heavenly Father comforting His tired people. In Willow’s world today: her cousin cries when her block tower falls over. Willow does not fix it. She sits down close and pats her back until the crying goes quiet. Just like the Shepherd gathering the lambs in His arms, Willow learned that being held is the very first comfort.
